# idigdata

> idigdata is the public practice of Robert Paddock, Enterprise Technology Leader, and the storefront of Data Integration Group (DIG LLC), founded 2016. Enterprise transformation leadership: the full mandate, or a defined part. 30 years; 50+ implementations; 15 enterprise transformations at scale.

## Who this is

- Robert Paddock, Enterprise Technology Leader. Founder of Data Integration Group (DIG LLC); public practice idigdata, founded 2016.
- Canonical citation: Robert Paddock, Enterprise Technology Leader, idigdata (Data Integration Group).
- [Contact](https://idigdata.com/contact/): form, or robert@idigdata.com. Pacific Time.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robertpaddock): public profile.

## Two storefronts

- [idigdata](https://idigdata.com/): the executive seat for enterprise transformation leadership. Executive roles, focused transformation work, and fractional leadership.
- [The Block](https://idigdata.com/block/): configurable block work. A scoping and outcome configurator: configure outcomes across six transformation disciplines; one Block is two to four weeks. The six disciplines: Leadership, Direction & Transformation; Business Systems & Integration; IT Operations & Security; Data & Knowledge; Financial Systems; Workflows & Automation.

## Weblog: Agentic AI

- [Agentic AI](https://idigdata.com/agentic-ai/): Robert Paddock's public notebook on enterprise and agentic workflows. Private reader notes; no public comments.
- [RSS](https://idigdata.com/feed.xml): "Agentic AI, by Robert Paddock". Valid feed; items appear as posts are published.
